title: Full Retry Journey
description: Walk one invoice through its entire life at the counter: generated, declined, retried and timed out, retried again and paid, then the receipt downloaded — every UI state along the way has to be correct, not just the final one.
successCondition: A test books a shipment, generates an invoice in EUR, confirms the initial Badge reads "open"; pays with the declined card and confirms the Badge stays "open" and one attempt line appears; retries with the timeout card and confirms the Badge still reads "open" and a second attempt line appears; retries a third time with an ordinary card and confirms the Badge flips to "paid", the payment form disappears, and a third attempt line reading "succeeded" appears; finally clicks "Download PDF" and confirms a request to GET /api/billing/invoices/:id/pdf returns Content-Type application/pdf.
hints: This is one continuous invoice, not three separate ones — don't regenerate between attempts.
Check the Badge state after every single attempt, not just at the end — an intermediate implementation bug (e.g. flipping to paid on a declined attempt) would otherwise slip through.
